title: Open Drains

items.label: Missing Cover
items.description: A pedestrian steps around an uncovered roadside drain opening.
items.visual_focus: an uncovered drain opening and a pedestrian foot stepping around it
items.local_cue: a narrow open concrete roadside drain beside a Rajshahi footpath

items.label: Overflowing Water
items.description: Rainwater spills from a drain and pushes across a walking path.
items.visual_focus: water visibly spilling from a drain onto the walking path
items.local_cue: a low concrete roadside drain overflowing onto a bazaar-side walkway

items.label: Dumped Cups
items.description: A person drops used cups into a roadside drain.
items.visual_focus: a hand dropping disposable cups directly into a drain opening
items.local_cue: a disposable tea cup falling into a narrow open concrete roadside drain

items.label: Sand Runoff
items.description: A worker washes construction sand toward a drain as rain begins.
items.visual_focus: sand and muddy water flowing together into a drain
items.local_cue: rainwater and construction sand flowing toward a concrete roadside drain

items.label: Broken Drain Edge
items.description: A small damaged drain edge is cordoned off while people detour around it.
items.visual_focus: a broken drain rim behind a temporary barrier with a pedestrian detouring
items.local_cue: a broken lip of a concrete roadside drain beside a small Bangladeshi shop

items.label: Clearing Debris
items.description: A cleaner pulls mixed rubbish from a drain mouth with no catch basket.
items.visual_focus: a cleaner's rake pulling a clump of rubbish from a drain mouth
items.local_cue: a municipal cleaner raking plastic and leaves from an open concrete roadside drain

questions: Which two scenes are most dangerous for someone walking?
Where have you had to avoid water or an open drain in Rajshahi?
Should the first effort cover open drains or clear blocked ones? Why?
Why might rubbish keep entering a drain after it is cleaned?
If a drain is covered, what could make future cleaning harder?
You have 200,000 BDT and 30 days. What one drain-safety fix would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Trial covers or debris catches at a small number of hazardous drains.

evidence.basis: supplied brief plus current civic work
